$comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-catalog.mjs. Read this first, then look up full entries (settings, blocks, params, examples) by id in CATALOG.json — or `npm run settings -- list`.

entries.name: Age verification
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only, for stores that legally require visitors to confirm their age.

entries.name: Anchor navigation
entries.use_when: long product pages or landing pages (Highlights · Features · Specs · FAQs), brand stories, guides.

entries.name: Announcement bar
entries.use_when: header group only, for store-wide notices (shipping policy, returns, launch news). Only state real offers — no fake urgency.

entries.name: Blog posts
entries.use_when: "From the blog" on the home page or landing pages, and related / latest posts under an article.

entries.name: Bundle builder
entries.use_when: home or landing pages that sell "pick any 3" / "mix and match" sets. For a fixed set of add-ons on the product page use the product-addons block.

entries.name: Cart drawer
entries.use_when: never add to templates — the layout renders it when Theme settings → Cart → Cart type is "Drawer".

entries.name: Cart recommendations
entries.use_when: never add to templates — requested by the cart drawer through routes.product_recommendations_url.

entries.name: Collage
entries.use_when: mood boards, shop-by-category mosaics, a campaign wall mixing lifestyle images, a video and hero products.

entries.name: Collection list
entries.use_when: "Shop by category / room / character" entry points on the home page or landing pages. For hand-made tiles with custom text use "image-cards".

entries.name: Complementary (script)
entries.use_when: never add to templates — the product-complementary block loads it.

entries.name: Contact form
entries.use_when: the contact page (with or without a map), wholesale or press enquiry pages, warranty or support request pages.

entries.name: Container
entries.use_when: building new page content from existing blocks; placing a custom block on a page; landing pages; any content that has no dedicated section.

entries.name: Cookie banner
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only, when you want a themed banner instead of Shopify's own (turn Shopify's banner off in Settings → Customer privacy).

entries.name: Countdown
entries.use_when: a sale, drop or pre-order window that really ends at a specific time. Never for fake urgency: no looping or per-visitor timers.

entries.name: FAQ
entries.use_when: FAQ pages, product-page questions, shipping / returns / sizing explanations, setup help. Answers can be connected to product or page metafields (dynamic sources) so one answer is maintained once and reused on several templates.

entries.name: Featured collection
entries.use_when: showing products on the home page or landing pages ("Best sellers", "New arrivals", a product line).

entries.name: Featured collections tabs
entries.use_when: the home page or landing pages need several product sets in the space of one ("Shop by line", "Pro / Lite"). For one collection use "featured-collection".

entries.name: Featured product
entries.use_when: home page or landing pages that spotlight one product ("Hero product", "New release"). For the product page itself use main-product.

entries.name: Features
entries.use_when: key product facts ("Bluetooth 5.4", "IPX7 washable"), store promises (shipping, returns, secure checkout), "why us" rows.

entries.name: Floating side bar
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only (rendered on every page by the layout) — a persistent "follow us" / "get 10% off" handle at the screen edge.

entries.name: Footer
entries.use_when: footer group only.

entries.name: Header
entries.use_when: header group only. Do not add to page templates. Menu items come from Online Store → Navigation; the logo from Theme settings → Logo.

entries.name: Image banner
entries.use_when: first screen of the home page, campaign landing pages, collection intros — any large image with text on top.

entries.name: Image cards
entries.use_when: shop-by-category entry points, two-way splits (e.g. "Pro / Lite", "Men / Women"), campaign tiles.

entries.name: Image comparison
entries.use_when: showing a transformation or difference — before/after installation, cleaning, repair, two materials or finishes side by side.

entries.name: Image with text
entries.use_when: spotlighting one product or story ("Meet the X1 Pro"), brand story, about-page chapters.

entries.name: Text with inline images
entries.use_when: a brand statement or collection intro that mixes words and product or lifestyle pictures; a playful manifesto line between sections.

entries.name: Logo list
entries.use_when: "As seen in" press bars, retailer or partner logos, certifications and awards, payment or shipping partner rows.

entries.name: Lookbook
entries.use_when: showing products in use or in a room, "shop the look", explaining features on a photo, annotated product images.

entries.name: 404 page
entries.use_when: templates/404.json only.

entries.name: Customer account
entries.use_when: templates/customers/account.json only.

entries.name: Activate account
entries.use_when: templates/customers/activate_account.json only.

entries.name: Customer addresses
entries.use_when: templates/customers/addresses.json only.

entries.name: Blog post
entries.use_when: templates/article*.json only. Put related posts below it with the "Blog posts" section.

entries.name: Blog posts list
entries.use_when: templates/blog*.json only.

entries.name: Cart
entries.use_when: cart template only (templates/cart.json).

entries.name: Collection products
entries.use_when: collection templates (templates/collection*.json). Filters come from the Search & Discovery app.

entries.name: Collections list
entries.use_when: templates/list-collections.json (the /collections page).

entries.name: Customer login
entries.use_when: templates/customers/login.json only.

entries.name: Order details
entries.use_when: templates/customers/order.json only.

entries.name: Page
entries.use_when: templates/page*.json only.

entries.name: Password page
entries.use_when: templates/password.json only.

entries.name: Product information
entries.use_when: product templates (templates/product*.json). Change what appears in the info column by adding, removing or reordering its blocks; change the gallery in the section settings.

entries.name: Create account
entries.use_when: templates/customers/register.json only. Add "Registration field" blocks to collect extra details.

entries.name: Reset password
entries.use_when: templates/customers/reset_password.json only.

entries.name: Search results
entries.use_when: search template only (templates/search.json).

entries.name: Map
entries.use_when: store locations, showroom or pickup point pages, "Visit us" on the contact or about page, event venues.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.use_when: a moving divider between sections, a keyword band under the header or above the footer, a campaign slogan strip. Put it in the header or footer group to show the same strip on every page instead of repeating it in templates.

entries.name: Mobile dock
entries.use_when: footer group (or header group), when shoppers on phones need one-tap access to menu, search and cart while scrolling.

entries.name: Multicolumn
entries.use_when: selling points, store promises (shipping, returns, warranty), spec strips ("150 cm", "IPX7"), how-it-works steps, comparisons, "shop by" entry points with images. Column text and images can be connected to product or page metafields (dynamic sources) so the same facts are maintained in one place.

entries.name: Newsletter popup
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only (rendered on every page by the layout).

entries.name: Email sign-up
entries.use_when: collecting newsletter subscribers on the home page, above the footer, or on landing pages.

entries.name: People cards
entries.use_when: "Meet our designers", team / about pages, ambassadors, portfolio or case-study cards that need more text than fits on a card.

entries.name: Predictive search
entries.use_when: never add to templates — requested by c-predictive-search.js only.

entries.name: Product card (script)
entries.use_when: never add to templates — scripts fetch it by file name.

entries.name: Product comparison
entries.use_when: "compare models", "which one is right for me", thickness / size / edition comparisons. Fill the metafield per product in admin; no specs are typed into the theme.

entries.name: Quick view (script)
entries.use_when: never add to templates — c-quick-add.js loads it by file name.

entries.name: Product recommendations
entries.use_when: product templates, below the main product section.

entries.name: Recently viewed
entries.use_when: product pages (below recommendations), cart page, search page, 404 page — anywhere a "pick up where you left off" row helps.

entries.name: Reveal image with text
entries.use_when: a statement moment between sections — launch story, brand manifesto, one big product image with a short message.

entries.name: Rich text
entries.use_when: page intros ("Contact us", "Frequently asked questions" titles), short brand statements, call-to-action strips, contact details. Text can be connected to page or shop metafields with dynamic sources instead of typing it into several templates.

entries.name: Scroll reveal text
entries.use_when: a brand statement or manifesto between sections ("We believe…"), an about-page intro, a slow reading moment before a product story.

entries.name: Scroll story
entries.use_when: telling a product or brand story in 2–5 steps (how it's made, key features one by one, setup), usually on product or landing pages.

entries.name: Scrolling images
entries.use_when: brand moments, press or community photos, "as seen on", a moving strip of product shots or short slogans between sections.

entries.name: Search drawer
entries.use_when: never add to templates — the layout renders it when Theme settings → Search → Search type is "Drawer".

entries.name: Shop the feed
entries.use_when: bringing social content (Instagram, TikTok, UGC photos) onto the home page or a landing page and making it shoppable. For one large image with hotspots use "lookbook".

entries.name: Slideshow
entries.use_when: several campaigns or categories share the first screen of the home page; rotating promotional banners. For a single banner use "hero".

entries.name: Stats
entries.use_when: trust figures, impact numbers, product facts worth highlighting — only numbers you can back up.

entries.name: Tech specs
entries.use_when: product templates (below the main product) for technical products; also usable on landing pages with typed-in specs.

entries.name: Testimonials
entries.use_when: a few hand-picked, real customer or press quotes on the home page, product pages or landing pages. For live review data use a reviews app block instead.

entries.name: Timeline
entries.use_when: brand history ("Our story"), product generations, how an order is made, project or launch roadmaps.

entries.name: Video
entries.use_when: installation or brand videos, product demos, a video banner with a headline on top.

entries.name: Announcement
entries.use_when: only inside the announcement-bar section.

entries.name: Collage tile
entries.use_when: only inside the "collage" section.

entries.name: Column
entries.use_when: only inside the "multicolumn" section.

entries.name: Dock item
entries.use_when: only inside the mobile-dock section.

entries.name: Feature
entries.use_when: only inside the "features" section.

entries.name: Form field
entries.use_when: only inside the "contact-form" section, e.g. order number, topic dropdown, "I'm a business customer" checkbox.

entries.name: Image card
entries.use_when: only inside the "image-cards" section.

entries.name: Logo
entries.use_when: only inside the "logo-list" section.

entries.name: Phrase
entries.use_when: only inside the "marquee" section.

entries.name: Icon row
entries.use_when: inside product-icon-list (highlights) or product-trust (shipping / returns / warranty rows). Not placed on its own.

entries.name: Registration field
entries.use_when: only inside the "main-register" section, to ask new customers for more details (company, birthday month, how they heard about you).

entries.name: Scrolling tile
entries.use_when: only inside the "scrolling-images" section.

entries.name: Slide
entries.use_when: only inside the "slideshow" section.

entries.name: Spec tile
entries.use_when: child of the product-spec-tiles block (blocks source).

entries.name: Stat
entries.use_when: only inside the "stats" section, and only for figures you can verify.

entries.name: Testimonial
entries.use_when: only inside the "testimonials" section, and only with genuine quotes you have permission to publish.

entries.name: Button
entries.use_when: any clickable CTA such as "Shop now" or "Learn more".

entries.name: Collapsible row
entries.use_when: FAQs, product details such as specs / shipping / care, long content that should stay out of the way.

entries.name: Contact detail
entries.use_when: address, email, phone, opening hours, "Follow us" on contact pages, in the Map section's info card, or in any Container / Group.

entries.name: Countdown
entries.use_when: a real sale or launch deadline inside any section that accepts theme blocks (container, rich text, group, hero). Never for fake urgency.

entries.name: Divider
entries.use_when: separating groups of blocks, between a heading and a list, or as a vertical rule between items in a row.

entries.name: Email signup
entries.use_when: footer columns, inside groups on landing pages, anywhere a compact sign-up is needed (use the newsletter section for a full-width band).

entries.name: Group
entries.use_when: arranging existing blocks side by side inside a section (e.g. image next to heading + text + button), simple cards or columns. Repeating items with their own icon/text settings that operators edit often (badges, feature lists) are better as a custom block with child blocks.

entries.name: Heading
entries.use_when: titles and section headings. For paragraphs use the "text" block.

entries.name: Icon
entries.use_when: a small visual cue next to text in any section that accepts theme blocks — trust badges in a group, an icon above a heading, a linked social or contact icon.

entries.name: Image
entries.use_when: single images in any layout. For image + text side by side, put an image block and a group block inside a row container.

entries.name: Custom Liquid
entries.use_when: a one-off embed (third-party widget code, simple HTML). Prefer a real custom block for anything reused or styled.

entries.name: Country and language
entries.use_when: footer or header, once the store sells in several countries or languages (Settings → Markets, Languages).

entries.name: Logo
entries.use_when: footer brand column, landing-page headers, "about us" blocks.

entries.name: Map
entries.use_when: a store location inside a Container, Group or Image with text — "Visit our showroom", contact pages, event venues. For a full-width map with an info card use the Map section.

entries.name: Menu
entries.use_when: footer link columns ("Shop", "Help"), sidebars, sitemap-style lists.

entries.name: agentsws credit
entries.use_when: footer group of the open-source edition.

entries.name: Add-ons
entries.use_when: accessories, refills, warranties or "complete the set" offers on the product page. Real bundle discounts come from Shopify discounts (they apply at checkout).

entries.name: Badges
entries.use_when: product info column, above or next to the title ("show a sale badge", "add a label like Bestseller or Limited edition").

entries.name: Buy buttons
entries.use_when: product info column; any section that has a product.

entries.name: Complementary products
entries.use_when: product info column, to suggest accessories or add-ons. Set the pairs in the Shopify Search & Discovery app → Product recommendations → Complementary products.

entries.name: Countdown
entries.use_when: product info column, for a genuine limited-time offer ("sale ends in", "pre-order closes in"). Create the metafield (type "Date and time") in Settings → Custom data → Products and fill it per product.

entries.name: Product description
entries.use_when: product info column, on its own or inside a collapsible row.

entries.name: Highlights
entries.use_when: key selling points next to the buy buttons; product-specific highlights maintained in admin (metafield mode).

entries.name: Stock status
entries.use_when: product info column, near the buy buttons ("show stock", "low stock message", "only X left").

entries.name: Pickup availability
entries.use_when: stores with local pickup enabled (Settings → Shipping and delivery → Local pickup).

entries.name: Pop-up link
entries.use_when: size charts, delivery / returns details, care instructions or help text that should not crowd the product page. Edit the text in Online Store → Pages.

entries.name: Price
entries.use_when: product info column; any section that has a product.

entries.name: Rating
entries.use_when: product info column, usually under the title. Needs a reviews app that writes the standard metafields.

entries.name: Share row
entries.use_when: bottom of the product info column (or article pages) — a compact share + help line instead of the Share dropdown button.

entries.name: SKU
entries.use_when: product info column, for stores whose shoppers quote part numbers (spare parts, B2B, electronics).

entries.name: Spec tiles
entries.use_when: key numbers of a technical product (driver size, weight, battery, connectivity) under the gallery or in the info column; product-specific values maintained in admin (metafield mode).

entries.name: Specifications
entries.use_when: technical specifications, dimensions, materials, "what's in the box". Often placed inside a collapsible row.

entries.name: Product title
entries.use_when: product info column; any section that has a product (featured product).

entries.name: Trust rows
entries.use_when: under the buy buttons, to answer "when will it arrive / can I return it" before the shopper asks. Keep promises true to the store's policies.

entries.name: Variant picker
entries.use_when: product info column. Needs a section that switches variants (main product).

entries.name: Product vendor
entries.use_when: brand line above the product title (product info column, featured product, quick view) when the title block's own vendor line is not wanted, or when the vendor must sit elsewhere in the column.

entries.name: Share
entries.use_when: product info column, blog articles, gift or wish-list pages — anywhere shoppers may want to send the page to someone.

entries.name: Social links
entries.use_when: footer ("Follow us"), contact pages, about sections, anywhere a follow row is needed.

entries.name: Spacer
entries.use_when: extra breathing room between blocks that gap/padding settings cannot give.

entries.name: Text
entries.use_when: body copy, descriptions, short notes. For titles use the "heading" block.

entries.name: Video
entries.use_when: a product demo, how-to or brand film inside any section that accepts theme blocks (container, rich text, group, collapsible rows).
customer account forms, address forms, comment forms and other Shopify forms.
inside {% form 'customer_address' %} on the addresses page.
blog listing, "latest posts" rows and related posts.
article cards, the article page header and previous / next links.
fallback share row on the article page when no Share block is placed there.
article cards and the article page header.
product cards (media corner) and the product page badges block. Defaults follow Theme settings → Product cards → Badges.
page headers that show where the shopper is (collection header, later product or blog pages). Pass store URLs from routes.* or the object's .url.
inside product-card's media box, when Theme settings → Product cards → Show a sale countdown is on.
cart drawer and cart page, above the line items.
inside <aw-cart-items> in the cart drawer or on the cart page.
cart drawer and cart page checkout area.
the all-collections page or any grid of collections.
countdown section, countdown block, or any place that needs a real-deadline timer. Never use it for fake urgency.
collection and search result sections, once for the desktop sidebar and once inside the mobile filter drawer.
Outputs a Tailwind class string for a flex layout from editor settings.
showing the result of a Shopify form (account, address, comment, newsletter, contact) after it was submitted.

only inside sections/header.liquid.
the "Product highlights" block (metafield mode) and product cards' spec icons row — one parser for both.

header icons, drawer close buttons, chevrons, quantity steppers. Also: weight, plug, mic, waves, help, arrow-up.
header, announcement bar, menu drawer, footer — anywhere a country or language switch is needed. The localization block wraps this snippet for the editor.
only inside sections/lookbook.liquid.
map block, map section, contact form with map. Fill the parent box: the snippet is absolutely positioned inside a relative wrapper with a height.
inside every aw-marquee element, so moving content can always be stopped (WCAG 2.2.2).

inside a {% paginate %} tag on collection, search or blog pages.
play/pause buttons of videos, slideshows and other moving content.
product cards, product page price block, cart lines — anywhere a price is shown.
short product lists inside other content — complementary products, "complete the look", drawers.
any product grid or slider (collection, search, featured collection, recommendations).
product sections (main product, quick view, featured product).
rendered by snippets/results-grid for a section's local "promo" blocks (main-collection). Pass the block; it outputs a grid <li>.
inside product-card (quick_add param) or compact product rows.
product cards and bundle cards that show the rating on the image instead of a star row.
product cards and product pages, when a reviews app provides product.metafields.reviews.rating.
inside main-collection and main-search, within a {% paginate %} tag.
the top of content sections (multicolumn, FAQ, testimonials, logo list, timeline, stats, collection list, contact form) so every section heading looks and behaves the same.
media sections (collage, lookbook, image comparison, scrolling images) that have eyebrow / heading / heading_highlight / text / heading_alignment settings.
inside an aw-slider element, next to its track. Not needed for layouts that never scroll.
footer, announcement bar, menu drawer, "follow us" rows. For the editor-placeable version use the social-links block.
tech specs groups, product details accordions — anywhere specs are written as plain text (block setting or multi-line / list metafield).
collection page header or toolbar (main-collection → Subcollections).
deciding between swatches and buttons (variant picker, product card, filters). Capture the output.
colour options in the variant picker, colour previews on product cards and filters.

the video theme block, timeline items, or any block that shows one video.
any section or block that shows a video (video section, collage item). For a decorative looping background use the same snippet with autoplay: true.
